    },

      "name": "saved_variance",
      "formula": "G=M^-T, detG=1/p; G_prime=D G-G D_theta for theta=t^p",
      "proof": "differentiation of the previously proved actual horizontality; inverse is linearized, not additive substitution-surjectivity"
    },
    {
      "name": "central_graph_consumption",
      "formula": "sp(omega+eta)=2nu j_n(1), actual Phi fixes its graph image",
      "proof": "reuse the exact actual graph/basis arrow; no new functional or full-relative claim"
    }
  ],
